adql:
SELECT TOP 10000
    source_id, ra, dec, parallax, parallax_error, parallax_over_error,
    pmra, pmra_error, pmdec, pmdec_error, phot_g_mean_mag,
    phot_g_mean_flux_over_error, bp_rp, ruwe, random_index
FROM gaiadr3.gaia_source
WHERE random_index >= 500000000 AND random_index < 600000000
  AND parallax IS NOT NULL AND parallax_over_error >= 5
  AND phot_g_mean_mag IS NOT NULL AND bp_rp IS NOT NULL
  AND ruwe < 1.4
ORDER BY random_index ASC
limitations: Separate quality-selected cohort; not combined with PR2 catalog.
Only 15 fields: no position-error/correlation/photometric-flux-error fields or stellar classification probabilities.
CSV lacks per-field unit/UCD metadata and explicit TAP result status.
Offline importer does not verify these selection conditions; this independent audit does.
